sobre: Ficha de criação da arte da Ilha do Farol. Cada peça tem o prompt exato, o modelo e onde entra no jogo. Gerado no Kairogen; processado por arte/processar.py.
estilo: Soft flat 2D vector illustration in a calm children's picture-book style, the same art style as the reference image: thick rounded simple shapes, very low detail, soft matte pastel colors, gentle light highlights, no hard outlines.
proibicoes: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no ground shadow, no sparkles, no glitter, no busy details.
fundo_branco: Isolated on a pure flat white background (#FFFFFF) with a generous empty margin all around.

pecas.prompt: The exact same character as the reference image: Lume, the baby octopus, with the same shape, proportions, big round eyes and six tentacles. Body color: light warm apricot (#EDB978). Expression: calm, content and relaxed, like after a slow deep breath: the same big round friendly eyes fully open with soft relaxed eyebrows curved gently upward, and a small gentle closed-mouth smile. Not sleepy, not bored, not half-closed eyes. Front view, full body, centered.
